method: same VLM checklist, each final image evaluated independently, uncertain counted false

per_constraint.criterion: A golden retriever is present and recognizable.

baseline.reason: A golden retriever is clearly visible running on the left side of the image.

draftdag.reason: The dog present is not identifiable as a golden retriever.

per_constraint.criterion: A red tennis ball is present.

baseline.reason: A red tennis ball is visible at the end of the water arc.

draftdag.reason: A red tennis ball is clearly visible in the upper left of the image.

baseline.reason: A woman wearing a floral dress and hat is present in the center of the image.

draftdag.reason: A woman is present on the left side of the image.

per_constraint.criterion: The woman visibly adjusts or holds the garden hose nozzle.

baseline.reason: The woman is visibly holding and adjusting the garden hose nozzle.

draftdag.reason: The woman is visibly holding and adjusting the garden hose nozzle.

per_constraint.criterion: The hose water forms a curved arc.

baseline.reason: The hose water forms a curved arc towards the red ball.

draftdag.reason: The water from the hose forms a distinct curved arc.

per_constraint.criterion: A distinct terrier is visibly digging at the oak base.

baseline.reason: There is no distinct terrier visibly digging at the oak base; only a smaller dog is near the tree.

draftdag.reason: There is no distinct terrier visible digging at the oak base.

per_constraint.criterion: A bicycle leans against the fence.

baseline.reason: A bicycle is leaning against the fence in the background.

draftdag.reason: A bicycle is leaning against the fence on the right side.

per_constraint.criterion: The bicycle has a wicker basket containing wilted daisies.

baseline.reason: While there is a basket on the bicycle, it is not clearly identifiable as wicker or containing wilted daisies.

draftdag.reason: While the bicycle has a basket, it is not clearly identifiable as wicker nor does it visibly contain wilted daisies.

per_constraint.criterion: A pickup truck is present near the oak.

baseline.reason: A pickup truck is visible to the right of the tree.

draftdag.reason: A pickup truck is present near the oak tree.

per_constraint.criterion: The cat is visibly perched on the truck hood, not beside it.

baseline.reason: The cat is visibly perched on the truck hood.

draftdag.reason: There is no cat visibly perched on the truck hood.

per_constraint.criterion: A distant clock tower is visible.

baseline.reason: A distant clock tower is visible in the background on the left.

draftdag.reason: No distant clock tower is visible in the scene.

per_constraint.criterion: A drone is visible above the scene.

baseline.reason: A drone is visible flying above the scene in the sky.

draftdag.reason: No drone is visible above the scene.

per_constraint.criterion: A swarm of ladybugs is visible.

baseline.reason: A swarm of small red objects resembling ladybugs is visible along the water arc.

draftdag.reason: While there are small insects, they are not identifiable as ladybugs.

per_constraint.criterion: The ladybugs visibly form a continuous bridge or chain.

baseline.reason: The ladybugs are visibly forming a continuous bridge-like chain along the water arc.

draftdag.reason: There is no visible formation of ladybugs forming a continuous bridge or chain.

per_constraint.criterion: That ladybug bridge visibly runs from a low oak branch toward the red tennis ball.

baseline.reason: The ladybug bridge runs from a low oak branch (partially obscured) toward the red tennis ball.

draftdag.reason: Since there is no ladybug bridge, this endpoint relationship cannot be established.

limitations: One prompt, one stochastic generation per arm, one VLM evaluation per image; not a statistical result.
VLM judgments may be wrong; inspect image and reasons manually.
DAG uses extra LLM calls and hand-chosen coordinates; any gain is not attributable solely to DAG structure.
The final Qwen img2img stage redraws the whole canvas and may remove draft constraints.
